text: dsh-plugin-health-check 是 DSH 的静态体检插件，提供 plugin_health_check 工具，检查 profile 中 bundle 是否可解析、包版本是否兼容、patch 配置是否有问题，以及 MCP serverName 是否重复。也可将本地候选包加入模拟并比较新增发现，输出摘要和结构化报告。适合安装插件前检查 DSH 配置；需要 Node.js 22+ 和本机 profile，无需密钥或外部服务。

dsh-plugin-health-check checks DSH profiles before plugin installation. Its plugin_health_check tool finds unresolved bundles, incompatible versions, patch errors and duplicate MCP server names. It can compare results with a local candidate package. Requires Node.js 22+ and local profile access.
想在安装 DSH 插件前检查它是否会和现有 profile 配置冲突。
帮我找出 DSH 配置里无法解析的 bundle 和有问题的 patch。
检查当前 DSH profile 中插件声明的版本是否兼容运行时。
看看我的多个 MCP 配置有没有重复的 serverName。
Can I check a local plugin package against my DSH profile before adding it?
Find unresolved bundles, patch problems, and duplicate MCP server names in my DSH setup.
dsh-plugin-health-check 的功能「profile 检查」：读取 profile 的 bundle 与 patch 并报告静态配置问题，通过工具调用。
dsh-plugin-health-check 的功能「候选包预检」：比较加入本地包前后的新增发现，不安装或执行候选包。
dsh-plugin-health-check 的功能「MCP 检查」：检查传输参数及同作用域重复的 serverName。
帮我在不启动插件的情况下预览 profile 配置可能出现的问题。
Does my DSH profile have patch or package compatibility issues?

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Introduction：

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Introduction：---

DSH 的插件不是装进 `node_modules` 就生效。能不能加载，取决于 profile 选了哪些 bundle、patch 按什么顺序覆盖、包声明的版本 DSH 认不认。这些问题大多要重启之后才暴露，表现往往只是“某个东西悄悄没了”。

`dsh-plugin-health-check` 沿着 **profile → bundle → patch → 配置条目** 把这条链路在装之前走一遍。它不启动任何插件，不执行任何命令，不改动你的配置。

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Introduction：| 你遇到的现象 | 常见原因 | 对应发现 |
|---|---|---|
| 装完重启，插件没出现 | bundle 解析不到、没声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`、版本不被当前 DSH 接纳 | `DSH_PACKAGE` · `DSH_VERSION` |
| 配置被另一层悄悄换掉 | patch 按 id 整体替换 `config`；id 重复、覆盖未命中、include 成环 | `DSH_PATCH` |
| 两个 MCP 服务只剩一个 | 同一作用域里 `serverName` 重复，重复注册会被拒绝 | `R1` · `R8` |
| 检查结果为空，不知道算不算健康 | 动态表达式、未解析的模块、服务隔离 | `DSH_COVERAGE`，状态为 `incomplete` |

dsh-plugin-health-check README · 安装：作为 DSH 插件装进 profile，一条命令：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:GlariaLuminous/dsh-plugin-health-check
```

重启 DSH，然后直接对 agent 说：

> 检查我的 DSH 插件。

> 我想装 `/path/to/plugin`，会不会和现有插件冲突？

agent 会调用只读工具 `plugin_health_check`，后一句会把目录作为 `candidate` 传进去。

> **状态：实验性。** 检查引擎（命令行）已在 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 上验证。agent 工具入口较新：注册流程有不依赖宿主的测试覆盖，但还没有在真实 DSH 里长期使用。DSH 仍是开发者预览版，升级后请重新检查。遇到问题请带上 DSH 版本提交 issue。

只想跑命令行、不装进 profile：

dsh-plugin-health-check README · 安装：```bash
git clone https://github.com/GlariaLuminous/dsh-plugin-health-check.git
cd dsh-plugin-health-check
npm ci --ignore-scripts
node scripts/dsh_health_check.mjs --profile desktop

需要 **Node.js 22+**。默认读取 `$DSH_HOME`，未设置时使用 `~/.dsh`；`--profile web` 检查 Web profile，`--json` 输出结构化报告。参数全表见 [参考文档](docs/dsh.md)。

dsh-plugin-health-check README · 原理：

- **按宿主的规则读，不自己发明规则。** patch 合成用的是官方 `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-include` 的算法；版本准入遵循 DSH 的 `engines.dsh` 优先、否则看 DSH peers 的规则，预发布版本参与比较。 - **覆盖层顺序一致。** bundle → profile → home → 命令行 `--patch`，处理 disabled、分组、静态 include 和循环引用。 - **读得到 Desktop 内置包。** 直接读取 Electron ASAR 里的包元数据，不需要启动 Electron。

dsh-plugin-health-check README · 示例输出：

| 退出码 | 状态 | 含义 | |---|---|---| | `0` | `pass` | 已覆盖的静态配置检查通过 | | `1` | `fail` | 存在致命发现 | | `2` | `error` | 参数、路径或运行环境错误 | | `3` | `incomplete` | 覆盖不完整，需要补充信息或运行态核实 | JSON 报告包含 `packages`、`entries`、`findings`、`coverage`、`status` 和 `exit_code`。配置正文、凭据和 YAML 错误片段不会写进报告；本地安装路径会保留，便于定位，分享报告前请留意。

dsh-plugin-health-check README · 安装前模拟：把候选插件的本地源码或解包目录交给 `--candidate`：

```bash
node scripts/dsh_health_check.mjs --profile desktop --candidate /path/to/plugin --json
```

- 候选包**不会被安装**，也不会执行它的构建脚本或 `apply`。
- 同名包按包身份替换旧版本，不会被重复计入；否则作为新的一层加入。
- 报告只列出**新增**的问题，并保留原环境的 baseline。原环境本身失败或不完整时，不会给出干净的通过结论。

dsh-plugin-health-check README · 边界：这是静态检查。**未验证**的内容：运行时注册的工具、命令和 hook，Agent preset 的激活，MCP 的实际连接与 `tools/list`，会话里的实际权限。`!!js` 表达式只当数据，不会求值。

所以 `STATIC PASS` 的意思是“已覆盖的配置没有发现问题”，不是“插件能成功运行”，更不是“插件是安全的”。没有发现插件、版本未知或遇到动态配置时，结果会标记为 `incomplete`，不会因为没采集到数据就说“一切正常”。

dsh-plugin-health-check README · 相关工具：DSH 生态里已有几个体检类项目，侧重点不同，有重叠，也互补。以下据各项目的公开说明，细节以它们自己的 README 为准。

| 项目 | 侧重 |
|---|---|
| [dsh-plugin-doctor](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor) | 插件作者侧：manifest、patch、入口、文件、构建，以及打包后在全新 profile 里的安装验证 |
| [dsh-doctor](https://github.com/asdf17128/dsh-doctor) | profile 层：被整体替换丢掉的配置字段、指向不存在条目 id 的 patch、工具名冲突 |
| [dsh-xray](https://socket.dev/npm/package/dsh-xray) | 运行中的 DSH：实际加载了什么、上下文成本、运行时健康 |
| **dsh-plugin-health-check** | 用户侧：在你真实的 profile 上按官方算法合成后做静态检查，并支持安装前模拟候选插件 |

dsh-plugin-health-check README · 作为 skill 使用：不装成插件时，也可以把完整仓库放到下面任一位置，并在该目录执行 `npm ci --ignore-scripts`：

- `$DSH_HOME/skills/dsh-plugin-health-check/`
- `<项目根目录>/.dsh/skills/dsh-plugin-health-check/`

保留 `SKILL.md` 和 `scripts/` 的相对位置，然后使用 `/dsh-plugin-health-check`，或直接说“检查我的 DSH 插件”。skill 会指引 agent 从自己的目录执行检查，并在总结里保留覆盖范围。

dsh-plugin-health-check README · 开发：```bash
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
```

测试会创建临时 profile 和 ASAR，不依赖本机 DSH。CI 在 Ubuntu 和 Windows 上，用 Node 22 与 24 运行。

```text
src/                        # DSH 插件入口与 plugin_health_check 工具
  index.js  tool.js  report.js
cordis.patch.yml            # bundle patch：把插件插入 profile
scripts/

遇到漏报或误报，欢迎提交最小的 DSH profile/patch 示例、宿主版本和预期行为。分享前请移除配置里的凭据和个人路径。

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Introduction：

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Introduction：---

A DSH plugin does not work just because it sits in `node_modules`. Whether it loads depends on which bundles the profile selects, how patches override each other, and whether the package's declared versions are admitted by DSH. Most of these problems only show after a restart, usually as something quietly missing.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Introduction：`dsh-plugin-health-check` walks **profile → bundle → patch → configuration entries** before you install anything. It starts no plugin, runs no command and changes none of your configuration.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Introduction：| What you see | Usual cause | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| Plugin missing after restart | Bundle does not resolve, no `dsh.bundle.patch`, version not admitted by this DSH | `DSH_PACKAGE` · `DSH_VERSION` |
| Config silently replaced by another layer | A patch replaces `config` wholesale by id; duplicate ids, unmatched overrides, include cycles | `DSH_PATCH` |
| Two MCP servers, only one survives | Same `serverName` in one scope; duplicate registration is refused | `R1` · `R8` |
| Empty result, unclear if healthy | Dynamic expressions, unresolved modules, service isolation | `DSH_COVERAGE`, status `incomplete` |

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Install：Add it to a profile as a DSH plugin:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:GlariaLuminous/dsh-plugin-health-check
```

Restart DSH, then ask the agent:

> Check my DSH plugins.

> I want to install `/path/to/plugin`. Will it conflict with what I have?

The agent calls the read-only `plugin_health_check` tool; the second request passes the folder as `candidate`.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Install：> **Status: experimental.** The check engine (CLI) is verified on DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2. The agent-tool entry is newer: its registration is covered by host-independent tests, but it has not been used in a real DSH session for long. DSH is a developer preview, so re-check after upgrades. Please file an issue with your DSH version if something is off.

CLI only, without installing into a profile:

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/GlariaLuminous/dsh-plugin-health-check.git
cd dsh-plugin-health-check
npm ci --ignore-scripts
node scripts/dsh_health_check.mjs --profile desktop

Requires **Node.js 22+**. Home defaults to `$DSH_HOME`, otherwise `~/.dsh`; `--profile web` checks the web profile and `--json` prints a structured report. All options are in the [reference](docs/dsh.md).
dsh-plugin-health-check README · How it works：

dsh-plugin-health-check README · How it works：- **Reads by the host's rules, not its own.** Patch composition uses the official `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-include` algorithm. Version admission follows DSH: `engines.dsh` wins, otherwise DSH peers are checked, with prereleases included.
- **Same layer order.** Bundle → profile → home → `--patch` overlays, with disabled and grouped entries, static includes and include cycles handled.
- **Reads Desktop's bundled packages.** Package metadata inside Electron ASAR files is read directly; Electron never runs.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Sample output：

| Exit | Status | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `0` | `pass` | Covered static checks passed | | `1` | `fail` | Fatal findings | | `2` | `error` | Input or setup error | | `3` | `incomplete` | Coverage is partial; more information or a runtime check is needed |

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Sample output：The JSON report has `packages`, `entries`, `findings`, `coverage`, `status` and `exit_code`. Config bodies, credentials and YAML error excerpts are left out; local installation paths are kept for diagnosis, so mind them before sharing a report.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Dry run before installing：Pass a local source or unpacked package directory to `--candidate`:

```bash
node scripts/dsh_health_check.mjs --profile desktop --candidate /path/to/plugin --json
```

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Dry run before installing：- The candidate is **never installed**, and its build scripts and `apply` never run.
- A package with the same identity replaces the installed one instead of being counted twice; otherwise it joins as a new layer.
- Only **new** findings are listed, next to the baseline of your current setup. A failing or incomplete baseline prevents a clean verdict.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Limits：This is static inspection. **Not verified:** runtime-registered tools, commands and hooks; Agent preset activation; real MCP connections and `tools/list`; effective session permissions. `!!js` expressions stay data and are never evaluated.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Limits：So `STATIC PASS` means "the covered configuration shows no problem". It does not mean the plugin runs, and it does not mean the plugin is safe. When no plugin is found, a version is unknown or configuration is dynamic, the result is `incomplete`; missing data is never reported as healthy.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Related tools：The DSH ecosystem already has several checkers with different focus. They overlap in places and complement each other. The summaries below follow each project's public description; their own READMEs are authoritative.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Related tools：| Project | Focus |
|---|---|
| [dsh-plugin-doctor](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor) | Plugin author side: manifest, patch, entry, files, build, and a pack + fresh-profile install check |
| [dsh-doctor](https://github.com/asdf17128/dsh-doctor) | Profile level: config fields dropped by whole-config replacement, patches that target missing entry ids, tool-name collisions |
| [dsh-xray](https://socket.dev/npm/package/dsh-xray) | A running DSH: what is actually loaded, context cost, runtime health |
| **dsh-plugin-health-check** | User side: static checks on your real profile composed with the official algorithm, plus a dry run for a candidate plugin |

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Use as a skill：Without installing it as a plugin, place the complete repository under either location and run `npm ci --ignore-scripts` there:

- `$DSH_HOME/skills/dsh-plugin-health-check/`
- `<project-root>/.dsh/skills/dsh-plugin-health-check/`

Keep `SKILL.md` beside `scripts/`, then invoke `/dsh-plugin-health-check` or ask the agent to check your DSH plugins. The skill has the agent run from its own directory and keep the coverage limits in its summary.

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Development：```bash
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
```

Tests build temporary profiles and ASAR files, so no DSH installation is needed. CI runs on Ubuntu and Windows with Node 22 and 24.

```text
src/                        # DSH plugin entry and the plugin_health_check tool
  index.js  tool.js  report.js
cordis.patch.yml            # bundle patch: inserts the plugin into a profile
scripts/

dsh-plugin-health-check README · Development：For false positives or misses, please file a minimal DSH profile/patch example, the host version and the expected behaviour. Remove credentials and personal paths before sharing.
